props.name: direction
props.description: Main axis. Pass an object to change it at a breakpoint: `{ base: 'column', md: 'row' }`.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children, on the spacing scale — 4 is 16px.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Let children wrap onto further lines. Dividers are best left off when wrapping.

props.name: dividers
props.description: Draw a hairline between children, turning with the direction at each breakpoint.

props.name: children
props.description: The children, laid out in order.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render — `ul`, `section`, `nav`. Dividers become list items inside a list.
